what: Plays once at 25% visible. For the title, an accent-color band is painted from the left over .55s per line (the span right below), and when the band is about 70% painted, white text is revealed from the left over .55s (mask), each line .18s later. For a photo (look: photo), the band is painted from the left over 1.1s (to 60%) and then exits to the right, and from .42s later the photo is revealed from the left over .6s. All curves are cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1).

options.look: Default (title line) · photo (photo — what to paint is data-fx-part="media")
options.bg: Strip length (seconds), default .55 (photo .6 — sets when the photo starts to appear)
options.txt: Duration of the text/photo reveal (s), default .55 (photo .6)
